name: Idaho Supreme Potatoes Inc.
old_description: Idaho Pacific Holdings, Inc. is a family of potato dehydration companies spanning North America – from the nutrient rich farmlands of Idaho to the San Luis Valley of Colorado to the red sandy soils of Prince Edward Island, Canada.
about:
Idaho Supreme Potatoes operates in Firth, Idaho, where it began as a fresh potato packing operation in 1967. The facility added dehydration capacity in 1969 and grew into one of North America's leading potato dehydration plants. In 2018, Idaho Pacific Holdings acquired the company and continues its tradition of supplying dehydrated potato products worldwide.

The plant produces dehydrated potato flakes, flour, slices, dices, and shreds/hash browns, with ingredient specifications ranging from whole flake to finely milled flour, full-cook to low-leach, and additive-free clean-label options. Foodservice lines include blended or agglomerated mashed potato mixes, scalloped and au gratin casseroles, and seasoned or unseasoned hash browns. An in-house R&D team develops custom formulations. Packaging runs from poly pouches, gabled cartons, and #10 tins to kraft bags, bulk sacks, and bulk rail or truck loads, with private-label options for foodservice and retail.

Customers span foodservice distributors, retail brands, and industrial food manufacturers seeking potato ingredients for prepared meals, snacks, and bakery applications. The facility sources Russet varieties such as Burbank, Norkotah, and Ranger from Idaho's Snake River Plain.

The operation highlights its diverse production capabilities, custom specification development, private-label packaging, bulk rail and truck logistics, and certifications under a GFSI-benchmarked standard, Kosher (OU), and Halal (IFANCA).
